notes: Fixes the Weekly diary maths. On an exchange tab (ASX/NYSE) the daily snapshots only record what holdings are worth and what was paid for them — they carry no whole-account equity figure — so the previous build read equity as zero and printed Open moved as exactly minus the Closed figure, zeroing every week total. It now picks the right measure for the series it has: unrealised profit change on an exchange tab, account equity change minus realised profit on the whole-account view, and an honest dash when neither is available.
